name: The Landmark Mandarin Oriental
positioning: Joyce Wang-designed hotel in Central, Hong Kong, connected to the LANDMARK shopping complex
best_for: Travelers who want a Central Hong Kong base with Michelin-starred dining in the hotel
Guests who like suite-style rooms with a residential feel

facts.text: The hotel has 109 rooms and suites.
The hotel is at 15 Queen's Road Central in Central, Hong Kong.
The hotel was reimagined by designer Joyce Wang.
The hotel has a terracotta-tiled facade.
The hotel is directly connected to the LANDMARK luxury shopping complex with interconnecting access.
Amber, serving contemporary French cuisine, is a three-Michelin-starred restaurant on the 7th floor.
Sushi Shikon is a three-star Michelin restaurant serving Edo-style sushi.
Rin serves modern Japanese cuisine and has one Michelin star.

highlights.text: The hotel's 109 accommodations are crafted as expansive suites, in the hotel's words.
The L600 Junior Suite has a signature 7-foot round bathtub.
Chef Richard Ekkebus is Culinary Director of the hotel.
BLANC DE NOIRS is a champagne cocktail bar with a 500-label cellar.

considerations.text: The hotel's wellness area is reopening in Winter 2026.
Amber can be accessed via the hotel entrances on the Ground Floor, Basement 1, or Level 3 of LANDMARK Mall.
Sushi Shikon has an intimate eight-seat hinoki counter.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the ultra-luxury positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
